headline: The Giants opened the door on Logan Webb, and now the pitching market has a second ace that doesn't wait on Skubal.

news.title: Giants open to trading Logan Webb
news.note: San Francisco will now listen on its three-time All-Star, a reversal from the deadline. He's signed through 2028.

news.title: Mets extend A.J. Ewing for eight years
news.note: The 22-year-old outfielder is now under control through 2035. It's the Mets' first big long-term extension under Stearns.

news.title: Seven teams chase Freddy Peralta
news.note: Rosenthal and Sammon list the Rays, White Sox, Cubs, Padres, Blue Jays and two unknown clubs. He could sign before Skubal does.

news.title: Yankees fielding calls on Spencer Jones and Jasson Domínguez
news.note: Cashman says teams are 'asking a lot' about Jones, who's in line to start in center.
Doval avoided arbitration at a reported $6.3M after a 4.30 ERA between the Yankees and Pirates. Koss went to Tampa Bay for minor-league RHP Cole Stokes.
news.title: Giants keep Doval for one year, trade Koss to the Rays

news.note: Jim Duquette reported the offer; it would be the highest AAV ever for a free-agent starter. Skubal has met the Mets, Dodgers, Blue Jays, Padres and a fifth team over Zoom, and is expected to pick by Dec. 1.
